question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Dr. Oppenheimer is the exceptional movie of all the movies in recent times.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**the exceptional movie**" is grammatically incorrect in the given context.
 
• The use of "**the exceptional movie**" suggests that Dr. Oppenheimer is the only exceptional movie, which is inappropriate when comparing it to other movies.
 
• When making comparisons, the superlative form "**the most exceptional movie**" should be used to indicate that Dr. Oppenheimer stands out among all movies in recent times.
 
• Thus, the error lies in **Option 4**, where the superlative form of the adjective is required for proper comparison.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Dr. Oppenheimer is the most exceptional movie of all the movies in recent times."*
